title: Toughbook programs lured UFOs and downed them with EMP weapons
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Toughbook programs lured UFOs and downed them with EMP weapons, about 2020s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: From an insider leak, we now know that the programs documented on these Toughbooks used temporary flight restrictions to [music] clear the skies, lure UFOs in, and bring them down with EMP weaponry.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a leak from an insider revealed what was recorded on certain Toughbooks, tough military-style laptops, from the 2020s. According to Michels, the programmes on them used temporary flight restrictions, rules that close a patch of US airspace to normal planes, to clear the sky, draw UFOs in, and bring them down with EMP weapons, which send out a burst of energy that knocks out electronics. If true, it would mean the US was actively capturing unknown craft.
